tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: :rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus zab mo gter gyi mdzod las: gsol 'debs rgyud bskul gyi bkol byang bzhugs:

rtsa gsum yongs 'dus lha la 'dud: rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs kyi: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul ba las: byin rlabs mngon sum 'byung ba'i phyir: bsnyen sgrub kun gyi thog ma dang: bar du dzap kyi phrin las dang: tha ma dngos grub blang ba sogs: dus dang rgyun gyi gnas skabs kun: mos pa'i gdung shugs drag po yis: rtse gcig snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas: gsol 'debs rgyud bskul 'di ltar bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma bcos spros med 'od gsal pho brang nas: dgongs klong 'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes brnyes: kun bzang rigs lnga sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud bla ma'i tshogs: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: ka dag lhun grub dbyer med ye shes dbyings: chos sku'i dgongs pa rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lhun grub bde chen mchog gi pho brang nas: rnam 'phrul du mas chos sgo mtha' yas ston: rigs gsum rigs can tshom bu 'bum phrag sogs: brda brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: gsol ba 'debs so brda brgyud rig 'dzin tshogs: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: mkhyen brtse nus ldan rang byung 'od lnga'i klong: longs sku'i ye shes rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi pho brang nas: mdo sngags rgyud sde'i gsang ba thams cad 'dzin: mthu stobs nus pas bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs 'dul: bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs:

gsol ba 'debs so dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: ye shes dgongs pa rmad du byung ba'i dbyings: gsang 'dzin nus rtsal 'chang ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi pho brang nas: gzungs dang spobs pa mkhyen pa'i gter chen 'chang: 'gro ba'i mun sel ye shes snang ba che: bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib gnyis dag pa'i dbyings: mkhyen gnyis ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥhūm̐ swā hā: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi pho brang nas: byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dong nas sprugs: bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs la gsol: gsol ba 'debs so 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter: byin gyis= byang chub sems kyi rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i dbyings: 'brel tshad don ldan chen po'i dngos grub= oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: rdo rje sems dpa'i 'od kyi pho brang nas: yi dam lha dang dbyer med bde ba che: sa bcu rgyun mtha'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur: dga' rab sprul pa'i sku la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so rig 'dzin dga' rab rje: byin gyis= phung khams skye mched rtog tshogs dag pa'i dbyings: ye shes sgyu ma brnyes pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru pra he badzra sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bde chen rdo rje brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: rgyud lung man ngag glegs bam char chen babs: gsang bdag byin brlabs dgongs brgyud ye shes brnyes:

skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥl gsol= gsol ba 'debs so rig 'dzin rgyal po dzaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: rgyud lung man ngag zab don thig le'i dbyings: chos kyi gter mdzod brdol ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru rā dza dzaḥsarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: rdo rje gdan mchog theg dgu'i pho brang nas: zab gsang rdzogs chen rtogs pa mngon du gyur: rig rtsal dbang thob snang srid 'dod rgur sgyur: shrī siṃ ha'i zhabs la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so rig 'dzin shrī sing: byin gyis= snang bzhi'i 'od gsal rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i dbyings: chos nyid zad sar 'khyol ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru shrī siṃ ha sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: mkhas pa'i 'du gnas rab snang pho brang nas: bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan rmad du byung: sde snod rgyud sde smra ba'i bshes gnyen che: sangs rgyas gsang ba'i zhabs la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so rig 'dzin sangs rgyas gsang: byin gyis= gzungs dang spobs pa mtha' yas 'od gsal dbyings: lung rtogs ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru buddha gupta sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i pho brang nas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo mchog: o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: ye shes yon tan bsam mi khyab pa'i dbyings: don gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i pho brang nas: tshad dang sku yi bkod pa bsam mi khyab:

yid bzhin nor ltar gang 'dul phrin las mdzad: padma thod phreng rtsal la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so padma thod phreng rtsal: byin gyis= mchog dang thun mong phrin las 'dus pa'i dbyings: bsam pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'chi med gnyug ma rdo rje'i pho brang du: zag pa gsum zad lam mchog yongs su rdzogs: mi shigs sku brnyes mkha' spyod dhā ki'i gtso: mandhā ra ba'i zhabs la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so dbyings yum mandā ra: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: tshe dang ye shes snang ba rgyas pa'i dbyings: 'pho med 'od skur 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ padma mandā ra sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba chen po 'dus pa'i pho brang nas: nye rgyu'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i gzi byin gyis: mi brjed gzungs thob bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad: ye shes mtsho rgyal zhabs la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so bde chen mtsho rgyal lcam: byin gyis= sa bcu lam lnga 'od gsal dbu ma'i dbyings: lhan skyes rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ḍā ki nī ma hā su kha siddhi hūm̐: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang byung bsil ba tshal gyi pho brang nas: dpal chen yang dag dgyes pa'i gar mdzad pas: 'od gsal snying po'i thig ler 'du 'bral med: rig 'dzin hūm̐ kā ra la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so slob dpon hūm̐ kā ra: byin gyis= ru lu 'bru brgyad gser gyi phreng ba'i dbyings: bsnyen sgrub yan lag mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru hūm̐ kā ra ru lu ru lu sarba siddhi hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtum drag sku la rdzogs pa'i pho brang nas:

zil gnon phyag rgya chen po'i dgongs pa brnyes: rdo rje'i sku mchog 'od kyi snying por shar: rig 'dzin mañdzu shrī la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so slob dpon mañdzu shrī: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: rang byung 'od gsal 'khor lo rnam bzhi'i dbyings: srid zhi'i rtog tshogs dag pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rab 'jigs lhun grub brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: dbang chen lha dang dbyer med ting 'dzin gyis: gsung rab mdzod brnyes chos sgo mtha' yas ston: rig 'dzin klu sgrub snying por gsol= gsol ba 'debs so slob dpon nā gārdzu: byin gyis= rta skad thengs gsum ka dag gnyug ma'i dbyings: theg dgu'i dgongs don rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru nā gārdzu na hya grī ba sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: mngon spyod laṅka brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i rtsal rdzogs pas: bdud sde'i dpung bcom rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas ston: rig 'dzin pra bha ha la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so slob dpon pra hasti: byin gyis= thal 'byin rnam bzhi'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbyings: srid gsum ye sgrol chen po'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru pra hasti kī li kī la ya sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: brtul zhugs gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang nas: mngon rdzogs khrag 'thung grub pa'i ye shes kyis: snang sems dbang sgyur ma tshogs bran du bkol: rig 'dzin saṃskṛta la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so slob dpon saṃskṛta: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: rtsa rlung thig le byang chub sems kyi dbyings: khams gsum bde chen 'bar ba'i dngos grub stsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru dha na saṃskṛta gu hya dzñā na sarba siddhi hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro padma brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: dpal chen che mchog bdud rtsi'i bcud blangs pas: 'pho med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang brnyes: rig 'dzin bi ma la la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so slob dpon bi ma la: snang srid bdud rtsi'i bcud du 'khyil pa'i dbyings: grol ba bzhi ldan mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru bi ma la mi tra pañtsa a mṛta sarba siddhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: rngam bzhad he chen brdal ba'i pho brang nas: dregs pa kun 'dul dgongs pa'i srog thob pas: sa gsum gdug pa zil gnon phyag rgya brnyes: rig 'dzin gu hya tsand+rar gsol= gsol ba 'debs so slob dpon gu hya pa: byin gyis= gsang ba kun 'dus rdo rje 'bar ba'i dbyings: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma dag pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru gu hya tsand+ra badzra pā ṇi sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rtsub 'gyur lo ka brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: stobs ldan khrag 'thung rol pa'i byin rlabs thob: dmod pa'i mtshon chas log 'dren cham la phab: rig 'dzin shāntiṃ garbhar gsol= gsol ba 'debs so slob dpon zhi ba'i snying: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: rdzong 'phrang srog gsum mi phyed rdo rje'i dbyings: rtog tshogs rang sar grol ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru shāntiṃ garbha sarba duṣṭān siddhi pha la hūm̐ e dzaḥbhyo: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: bod yul sgrub gnas so so'i pho brang nas: rigs 'dus thod phreng rtsal gyis rjes su bzung: bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin rdzu 'phrul cir yang ston:

rje 'bangs 'dus pa'i tshogs la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so snyan brgyud bla ma rnams: byin gyis= rim gnyis dgongs pa dbyer med 'od gsal dbyings: 'gro 'dul rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru yo gī shwa ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: kā ya= oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku dang ye shes dbyer med pho brang nas: byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las rab 'byams kyis: skal ldan gdul bya'i re ba yid bzhin skong: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la gsol= gsol ba 'debs so rtsa gsum rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med thig le'i dbyings: mchog thun grub pa rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal dhe ba dhā ki nī badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshad med byams pa chen po'i pho brang nas: rtog tshogs dbyings su thim pa'i rtsal chen pos: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad bar chad sel bar mdzad: rdo rje rigs kyi pho nyar gsol ba= gsol ba 'debs so mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rigs: byin gyis= shin tu rnam dag 'od gsal mchog gi dbyings: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ra badzra dhā ka ha badzra dhā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'gro 'dul snying rje chen po'i pho brang nas: rmad byung yon tan thabs la mkhas pa yis: 'byor pa drug gi 'dod rgu 'phel bar mdzad: rin chen rigs kyi pho nyar gsol= gsol ba 'debs so re skong rin chen rigs: byin gyis= mi shigs dwangs ma 'od gsal chen po'i dbyings: tshe bsod ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ tsa ratna dhā ka ri ratna dhā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: rjes chags dga' ba chen po'i pho brang nas: rngam bzhad bde ba mchog gi ting 'dzin gyis: 'khor 'das legs tshogs ma lus dbang du mdzad: padma rigs kyi pho nyar gsol= gsol ba 'debs so chags med padma'i rigs: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: bde stong dbyer med sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbyings: khams gsum rtog pa dbang 'dus dngos grub stsol: oṃ hri padma dhā ka ni padma dhā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: khyab brdal btang snyoms chen po'i pho brang nas: drag gtum rdo rje khros pa'i mtshon cha yis: gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs ma lus thal bar rlog: las kyi rigs kyi pho nyar gsol ba 'debs: gsol ba 'debs so thogs med las kyi rigs: byin gyis rlobs shig smin grol dbang mchog skur: rang bzhin kun khyab 'od gsal thig le'i dbyings: gnyis snang log 'dren tshar gcod dngos grub stsol: oṃ ya karma dhā ka sa karma dhā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgongs brda snyan brgyud dus gsum bla ma dang: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i yi dam zhi khro'i lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes rjes su bskul: rtse gcig mos pa'i gdung bas gsol 'debs na: byams pa'i zhal bzang mngon sum bstan du gsol: gsung gi gdams pa'i bdud rtsi bstsal du gsol: thugs kyi dgongs pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mtshan dpe'i sku yi gzi byin lus la phob: lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags sbyangs: bskyed rim phyag rgya'i ye shes mngon gyur nas: sku yi rdo rjer 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshangs dbyangs sngags kyi nus pa ngag la phob: ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags sbyangs:

rdzogs rim rlung sems ye shes mngon gyur nas: gsung gi rdo rjer 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'od gsal thugs kyi dgongs pa yid la phob: yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags sbyangs: lhan skyes dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon gyur nas: thugs kyi rdo rjer 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gsang gsum dbyer med rig rtsal rgyud la phob: sgo gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags sbyangs: mi phyed snying po'i ye shes mngon gyur nas: bde chen rdo rjer 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bdag dang mkha' khyab sems can ma lus kun: rtsa gsum 'dus pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: dbang bskur byin brlabs smin grol dngos grub thob: tshom bu gcig tu grol bar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra shānti ka ma hā kro dha sarba siddhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi hūm̐: kā ya siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wā ka siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī:

de ltar rtag tu mos gus kyis: snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i bur: padma bdag gis mngon sum du: byin gyis brlab 'gyur tha tshig yin: gegs sel bogs 'don mthar thug pa: 'di las gzhan du ngas ma bstan: de phyir padma'i rjes 'jug rnams: thugs dam snying po 'di la dril: sa ma ya: gsol 'debs rgyud bskul byang bu 'di: mnga' bdag yab sras rnams la gdams: sprul pa'i lo tsā chen por gtad: mtsho rgyal mos pas yi ger bris: rin chen sa yi bcud du gtams: ma 'ongs bdag gis byin brlabs pa'i: rig 'dzin zung dang 'phrad nas kyang: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu hya: 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas lha mdo 'bur mo bde chen padma bkod nas dngos grub tu thob pa'o/// /
